scripts.integrate: if [ "$(uname -m)" = "arm64" ] || [ "$(uname -m)" = "aarch64" ]; then echo 'SKIP: MSSQL SQL Server image does not run under QEMU emulation on ARM64. Requires an x86_64 host or Rancher Desktop with Rosetta 2 enabled.'; exit 0; fi && export MSSQL_PASSWORD="$(openssl rand -base64 32)" && docker compose up -d --wait && jest --config=../../jest.integration.config.js --rootDir=.; R=$?; docker compose down; bash -c "exit $R"
